note: R1 recipe v2 — authored over 27/27 declared contracts.
A step is VERIFIED only when its contract AND its position are evidence-backed.
Position evidence comes from TWO sources, both legitimate: a step's own Order line,
OR another step's Order line naming it (an edge stated by either endpoint is an edge —
merge_event and scope_event_staff are placed entirely this way).
17 of 27 contracts declare IO but no order. Those steps are NOT in this list: an
unplaced step is visible work, an invented placement is a silent one.
RULE 2 `once`: refuses when outputs exist (destructive-if-repeated).
RULE 3 `validator`: always runs, never hash-skipped, exit code gates.
TWO ANTI-EDGES, both from contracts: build_rdl01_shell must never run after
grow_rdl01_stg, and build_fdl_host_stg must not either — it reads the template the
shell writes, and grow changes it underneath.
v3 merges Foundry's §591 (11 steps, three sub-graphs, each edge quoted).
CORRECTION to their weakest edge: restore_arc_resids is CONFIRMED, not merely purposive —
bake_room_chunks, plyr_append, revt_bake AND mult_trim all call pack_rarc, which is exactly
what restore_arc_resids repairs. It is therefore placed after the LAST repacking step across
ALL sub-graphs, not just after plyr_append: the edge is real and wider than drawn.

v4: 27/27 placed. arc_add_member's edge is a CAPABILITY edge — adapt_bdl_arcs can only edit members in existing slots, never add one, so anything new must be added after. extract_bmg is genuinely independent (no consumer); grouped, not depended on.
v5 adds `path` — the LINEAGE of each step, distinct from `tier` (which is evidence quality).
NATIVE      — ports donor-authored data/behaviour into the receiver's own systems.
MOUNT       — host-stage scaffolding from the mount era; a native room path may replace it.
ASSET       — donor asset conversion; needed under either architecture.
COMPENSATOR — exists ONLY because a native system does not exist yet. RETIRES when it does.
UNCLASSIFIED— owner has not ruled. NOT a synonym for MOUNT; do not infer.
WHY: the pipeline was caught mid-transition. Labelling it turns that from a defect into the
recipe's most useful property — a burn-down. Count the COMPENSATOR + MOUNT steps; if that
number falls as native ports land, the transition is real. If it rises, the mount is deepening.
№116 already proved the mechanic: the sky bake retired the day the runtime feed made it moot.
